profile.name: illustrative-ram-80
profile.assumptions: Synthetic sensitivity scenario, not measured hardware. Serial accesses; no overlap, DMA, coherence, store buffer or dirty writeback. RAM latency precedes data beats.

model.policy: serial LRU; non-inclusive; write-through + write-allocate at both levels

reports.attribution: self PC; stack windows include callbacks/assertions; cache state includes harness
